Page Content 20

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Radio-wave propagation

Propagation of radio-waves in ionized and non-ionized media and the characteristics of radio noise, for the purpose of improving radiocommunication systems.

More​   

​

Structure

  • Working Party 3J (WP 3J) - Fundamentals of radio-wave propagation in non-ionized media
  • Working Party 3K (WP 3K) - Radio-wave propagation prediction for point-to-area propagation paths​
  • Working Party 3L (WP 3L) - Ionospheric and ground-wave propagation prediction and radio noise
  • Working Party 3M (WP 3M) - Radio-wave propagation prediction for point-to-point paths and paths between the Earth and space​​​​​​
  • ​Rapporteur and Correspondence G​roups of​ ​​WP 3J,WP 3K​,WP 3L and WP 3M
